title: DiscoveryCurveRequest
description: The per-step effects of a sensitivity sweep (POST /discovery/curve, docs/adr/0032-sensitivity-discovery-sweeps.md): for each observable, the variant-minus-baseline effect of every step, each step its own experiment against the same baseline.

parameter.description: The setup item (a linked group's leader) the sweep moved.

level.description: Level of every test of the classification; 0.9 when left out.

CurveObservable.title: CurveObservable
CurveObservable.description: One observable (metric, phase, speed regime) measured at each step of the sweep.

source.title: CurveSource
source.description: verdict: a channel of the step's verdict (block-level, ADR 0029). response: a cell of the step's response analysis (ADR 0031).

role.description: For a verdict channel: primary, guardrail, driver_input or prediction.

expected.title: CurveExpected
expected.description: For a response cell: whether the item's parameter row lists it (direct, proxy) or not (none).

margin.description: Half-width of the band of changes too small to matter, in the metric's unit. Without it the observable is never negligible.

CurveStep.title: CurveStep
CurveStep.description: The effect of one step: the variant, this many clicks from the baseline, minus the baseline.

clicks.description: Clicks of the step from the baseline; never 0.

look.description: Set when the interval is the repeated confidence interval of a pre-registered look (ADR 0029): its level is then the look's, wider than the nominal one.
